results.name: Bottom-up streams use the imaginary zero row and native repeat counts
Display-order rows and columns survive packing without transposition
The native consumer stops after 240 cells and preserves allocated tail bytes
Truncated commands, row overflow and repeated meta operands refuse
Packing is deterministic and favors a bounded row-copy representation
Only the edited room allocation changes; untouched source and allocated padding remain exact
No-op recipes preserve every byte, rather than normalizing compression
Native marker, border and room-setting cells cannot be changed by a terrain recipe
A compressed edit that cannot fit its original allocation fails before source mutation
Unknown room profiles and filenames cannot activate recovery or mutate the project
Shared source validation preserves generic CHR ownership and source identity rejection
Previously installed native adapters retain exact order and behavior
